output.title: Decreasing students' stress through time management training: an intervention study

scenes.narration: University students often face high levels of stress worldwide. Research suggests that time-related demands are a serious problem associated with these heightened stress levels.
scenes.layout_description: A student hunched over a desk with hands on their head, surrounded by floating clocks and calendars.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink sketch of a stressed student at a desk. Floating clocks and calendars have subtle orange and yellow accents. Cream background, plenty of white space.

scenes.narration: These time-related demands include high workloads, time pressure, and the challenge of self-organized learning, which can lead to unhealthy coping strategies and underachievement.
scenes.layout_description: A large clock face weighed down by heavy, stacked books.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black line art of a clock face being crushed by a tall stack of books. The clock hands are highlighted in orange. Cream background.

scenes.narration: To help students deal with these demands, time management interventions are often recommended. However, research concerning the effectiveness of such training programs is scarce.
scenes.layout_description: A magnifying glass hovering over a nearly empty folder labeled with a clock icon.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink drawing of a magnifying glass focusing on a single sheet of paper inside an otherwise empty folder. Yellow highlight on the glass. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The authors of this study wanted to examine the effects of a time management training program on perceived control of time and perceived stress.
scenes.layout_description: Two dials side-by-side, one with an arrow pointing up and the other pointing down.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist line art of two gauge dials. One dial's needle points to a yellow highlighted zone, the other to an orange zone. Cream background.

scenes.narration: They also wanted to look at the stability of these effects by measuring outcomes at two different points in time after the training ended.
scenes.layout_description: A horizontal timeline with a starting flag and two distinct checkpoints marked with circles.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink timeline. A starting flag on the left, followed by two circles highlighted in yellow and orange. Minimalist, cream background.

scenes.narration: Forty-eight undergraduate students from a German university initially volunteered for the study, attending a four-hour time management training program in the middle of the semester.
scenes.layout_description: A group of sketched figures sitting in chairs facing a whiteboard with a clock showing a four-hour span.
scenes.visual_prompt: Imperfect black line sketch of a small audience facing a whiteboard. A clock on the board has a pie-slice highlighted in orange representing four hours. Cream background.

scenes.narration: About half of the participants dropped out, leaving twenty-three students who completed all the questionnaires. These students had a mean age of twenty-three point three.
scenes.layout_description: A group of figures where exactly half are drawn with solid lines and yellow highlights, while the rest are faded out.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist ink drawing of multiple stick-figure outlines. Some are bolded with yellow circular accents behind them, while others are faint and dotted. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The researchers used a non-equivalent dependent variable design. They trained a single group and measured variables they expected to change alongside one they did not.
scenes.layout_description: A classic balancing scale with a glowing lightbulb on one side and a static square block on the other.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black line art of a balancing scale. The lightbulb side has an orange glow, while the square block side is plain. Cream background.

scenes.narration: This design helps rule out placebo effects. If only the expected variables change while the control variable remains stable, changes can be attributed to the training.
scenes.layout_description: A shield deflecting a capsule pill, with an arrow pointing straight through to a target.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink drawing of a shield bouncing off a medical pill, with a yellow arrow bypassing it to hit a bullseye. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The first dependent variable was perceived stress, which the researchers measured using the tension scale. This includes aspects like mental fatigue and feelings of nervousness.
scenes.layout_description: A stylized human head in profile with a tangled, jagged scribble inside the brain area.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist line art of a profile head. Inside the head is a jagged, tight scribble of black ink, accented with a sharp orange spark. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The second dependent variable was perceived control of time. This involves feeling in control, correctly estimating time for tasks, and being able to avoid procrastination.
scenes.layout_description: A hand firmly gripping a stopwatch.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch of a hand holding a stopwatch. The stopwatch face has a yellow highlight. Clean lines, plenty of white space. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The control variable was demands. This scale covers external duties and the amount of work students face, which the training was not designed to change.
scenes.layout_description: A tall, neat stack of paper documents and folders sitting on a desk.
scenes.visual_prompt: Imperfect black line art of a high stack of papers and folders. An orange arrow points at the stack, indicating external pressure. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The training itself focused on several major parts. Students learned how to prioritize their academic and extracurricular activities based on importance to their study goals.
scenes.layout_description: A numbered list on a clipboard, with the number one circled heavily.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist sketch of a clipboard with a list. The top item has a large, hand-drawn orange circle around it and an exclamation mark. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Next, the trainees defined concrete, proximal, and challenging goals. They developed strategies to achieve these goals, noting down different steps and anticipating possible obstacles.
scenes.layout_description: A staircase leading up to a flag, with a small hurdle drawn on one of the steps.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink staircase. A yellow flag sits at the top. A small hurdle is sketched on the middle step. Minimalist, cream background.

scenes.narration: The training also covered daily planning. Students developed concrete schedules, deciding exactly when and where they would complete tasks and how to avoid distractions.
scenes.layout_description: An open planner book showing a daily grid with specific time blocks shaded in.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black line drawing of an open daily planner. Several time blocks are shaded with orange and yellow diagonal lines. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Finally, the students were instructed to monitor their goal progress daily. They checked which tasks were successfully completed and what work still had to be done.
scenes.layout_description: A series of checkboxes, with a pen drawing a large checkmark in the top box.
scenes.visual_prompt: Imperfect black ink drawing of a hand holding a pen, making a bold checkmark in a square box. The checkmark is highlighted in yellow. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Participants filled out questionnaires directly before the training, two weeks after the training, and then again four weeks after the training session was completed.
scenes.layout_description: A timeline with three distinct clipboards placed along it at intervals.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink timeline. Three small clipboards sit on the line. The first is plain, the second has a yellow dot, the third an orange dot. Cream background.

scenes.narration: When looking at the results, the researchers found that trainees reported significantly less stress two weeks and four weeks after the training compared to the pretest.
scenes.layout_description: A line graph showing a line steadily dropping downward over three points.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black line graph. The plotted line moves downward from left to right, with an orange arrow emphasizing the downward trend. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Perceived control of time also increased, but with a time lag. Two weeks after training, there was only a moderate tendency in the expected direction.
scenes.layout_description: A line graph showing a line that is mostly flat but tilting very slightly upward at the middle point.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black line graph. The line goes from the first point to the second point with only a very slight, subtle upward angle. Yellow accent. Cream background.

scenes.narration: However, four weeks after the training, the trainees reported a significant increase in their perceived control of time compared to the measurement directly before training.
scenes.layout_description: A line graph showing a line shooting sharply upward at the final point.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black line graph. The line moves from the middle point to the final point with a sharp, steep upward angle. Orange highlight. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Meanwhile, the trainees reported no significant changes concerning demands at either two weeks or four weeks after the training, exactly as the researchers had hypothesized.
scenes.layout_description: A line graph showing a completely flat, horizontal line across all three points.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink line graph. The plotted line is perfectly flat and horizontal across three points. Simple, clean lines. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The researchers also checked if students actually used the taught strategies. Trainees reported a significant increase in time management behavior four weeks after the training.
scenes.layout_description: A figure actively writing in a planner, with an upward-pointing arrow beside them.
scenes.visual_prompt: Imperfect black line sketch of a person sitting and writing in a notebook. A bold yellow arrow points upward next to the notebook. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Interestingly, the training effect was much stronger for students who started with no or little time management experience compared to those with moderate or some experience.
scenes.layout_description: Two small potted plants: one growing slightly, the other growing massively into a large flower.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch of two identical pots. One has a small sprout, the other has a huge, blooming flower highlighted in orange. Cream background.

scenes.narration: The authors suggest that prioritizing, goal setting, and daily planning might give students more orientation, which reduces stress and fosters perceived control of time.
scenes.layout_description: A compass with its needle pointing clearly forward along a drawn path.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist line art of a compass sitting on a winding path. The compass needle is highlighted in yellow, pointing straight ahead. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Because of the small sample size, the authors note this should be seen as a preliminary study. More intervention studies with larger samples are necessary.
scenes.layout_description: A small cluster of three stick figures inside a dashed circle, with an arrow pointing to a much larger, empty dashed circle.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink drawing of three figures in a small dashed circle. An orange arrow points to a large, empty dashed circle waiting to be filled. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Future research might also compare time management training with other interventions designed to decrease perceived stress, like relaxation or meditation, to see what works best.
scenes.layout_description: A balancing scale holding a planner on one side and a figure in a lotus meditation pose on the other.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black line art of a scale. One side holds a daily planner, the other holds a minimalist figure meditating. Yellow and orange accents. Cream background.

scenes.narration: Still, teaching students how to prioritize tasks, set clear goals, and plan their work days might be good advice for universities to help decrease student stress.
scenes.layout_description: A university building with a calm, smiling student standing in front holding a planner.
scenes.visual_prompt: Imperfect black ink sketch of a university building with columns. In the foreground, a relaxed student holds a planner with a yellow sun above them. Cream background.
